ADMIN_ONLY_FIELD: Admin-only fields cannot be used in publishable or directly accessible filters
BLOCK_NOT_FOUND: Block not found or out of its validity window
CARD_STYLE_INVALID: Invalid card style (at most 20 entries, 64 characters each)
CHANNEL_NOT_FOUND: Channel not found or out of its validity window
CROSS_SOURCE_UNSUPPORTED: Cross-source filters are not supported yet
CURSOR_STALE: The filter or mount changed; reload from the first page
DIMENSION_UNMAPPED: The source does not map this dimension
FILTER_CODE_EXISTS: Another filter already uses this code
FILTER_CODE_INVALID: Code: lower-case letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter or digit, up to 64 characters
FILTER_EXCLUSIVE_PARAMS: Other condition parameters cannot be combined with filter
FILTER_IN_USE: The filter is mounted or referenced and cannot be deleted; unmount it first (see References)
FILTER_NAME_INVALID: Name is required, up to 100 characters
FILTER_NOT_FOUND: Filter not found or not published
FILTER_NOT_PUBLIC: Direct access is not enabled for this filter
FILTER_NOT_PUBLISHED: The filter has not been published and cannot be mounted
FILTER_SOURCE_MISMATCH: The filter's source is not accepted by this mount point or endpoint
FILTER_UNAVAILABLE: The filter module is not installed on this host
LIMIT_INVALID: Result cap must be between 1 and 10000
MIXED_CURRENCY_SORT: Amounts in different currencies cannot be sorted together
MOUNT_CONFLICT: The node already has an enabled mount with the same start time and an overlapping window
MOUNT_LIMIT_INVALID: Item limit must be between 1 and 100
MOUNT_MODE_NOT_ALLOWED: This mount point does not support the mode
MOUNT_PERMISSION_DENIED: You are not allowed to mount on this kind of node
NODE_CODE_INVALID: Code: lower-case letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter or digit, up to 64 characters
NODE_KIND_IMMUTABLE: Node kind cannot change after creation
NODE_NAME_INVALID: Name is required, up to 100 characters
NODE_REF_INVALID: Node ref must look like type:id
NODE_REF_TYPE_MISMATCH: The node type does not match the mount point
OPERATOR_NOT_ALLOWED: This field does not support the operator
PROJECTION_MISMATCH: The sub-filter projection type does not match
REF_NOT_FOUND: The referenced object does not exist (it may have been deleted)
SCHEDULE_INVALID: End time must be after start time
SORT_NOT_COMPARABLE: This sort key cannot be compared across sources
SORT_UNSUPPORTED: Only one sort key per filter
SOURCE_FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to build filters on this source
VALUE_TYPE_MISMATCH: The value does not fit the field type
